summary: 55-year-old Telluride resident Tim Cannon died of an apparent fall while hiking on Ruffner Mountain; his body was located during an extensive summer-long search by San Miguel County SAR and hundreds of BringTimHome volunteers after a good-Samaritan pilot spotted him from a fixed-wing aircraft over Telluride.
responding_agency: San Miguel County Search and Rescue
notes: Date is the date of death (7/8/2018 per family notice); body located later in the summer search. Resolves the pending KVNF Tim Cannon summer-2018 lead.
